verdict.detail: Discogs lists 5 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
Original 1971 Japanese first pressing with gatefold sleeve, insert, and obi.

This release includes the following:
(1) ¥2,000 printed on obi front, obi back (inside gatefold), and on the lower right corner on the back of the sleeve.
(2) The
company text credited in the disc label rim text and inside gatefold; not to be confused with its successor company

established in April 1972.
(3) Company inner sleeve advertising the "

" campaign which includes the front cover artwork from this release.

There are three obi variants for this release:
(1) Black obi (also included with

).
(2) Black obi (same as above), with affixed

(also known as the "Flower" obi).

Some copies of this first pressing had a foil ¥2,300 sticker placed over the original printed ¥2,000 price on the obi front, presumably in order to sell the remaining first pressings at the same price as the ¥2,300 second pressing.

The

, has ¥2,300 printed in the three price locations and Warner-Pioneer Corporation company text credited on disc labels and inside gatefold.

The
has a standard, non-gatefold sleeve, with a ¥1,500 price.
